("live_room_processor_events"."status" in ('processed', 'ignored') and "live_room_processor_events"."processed_at" is not null)
    or ("live_room_processor_events"."status" not in ('processed', 'ignored') and "live_room_processor_events"."processed_at" is null)

media_connector_links_resource_required.name: media_connector_links_resource_required
media_connector_links_resource_required.value: "media_connector_links"."project_id" is not null or "media_connector_links"."asset_version_id" is not null

moderation_events_room_menu_report_shape.name: moderation_events_room_menu_report_shape
moderation_events_room_menu_report_shape.value:
(
    "moderation_events"."entity_type" <> 'room_menu_item_report'
    and "moderation_events"."reporter_fingerprint" is null
    and "moderation_events"."requester_ip_hash" is null
    and "moderation_events"."report_window_started_at" is null
    and "moderation_events"."retention_expires_at" is null
  ) or (
    "moderation_events"."entity_type" = 'room_menu_item_report'
    and "moderation_events"."reporter_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    and "moderation_events"."requester_ip_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    and "moderation_events"."status" = 'held_for_review'
    and "moderation_events"."reason" is not null
    and length(trim("moderation_events"."reason")) between 1 and 500
    and jsonb_typeof("moderation_events"."metadata") = 'object'
    and octet_length("moderation_events"."metadata"::text) <= 4096
    and length(coalesce("moderation_events"."metadata"->>'details', '')) <= 2000
    and "moderation_events"."report_window_started_at" is not null
    and "moderation_events"."retention_expires_at" > "moderation_events"."created_at"
    and "moderation_events"."retention_expires_at" <= "moderation_events"."created_at" + interval '180 days'
  )

music_catalog_transfers_approval_complet.name: music_catalog_transfers_approval_complete
music_catalog_transfers_approval_complet.value: ("music_catalog_transfers"."artist_cutover_approved_by_user_id" is null and "music_catalog_transfers"."artist_cutover_approved_at" is null and "music_catalog_transfers"."artist_cutover_approval_fingerprint" is null) or ("music_catalog_transfers"."artist_cutover_approved_by_user_id" is not null and "music_catalog_transfers"."artist_cutover_approved_at" is not null and "music_catalog_transfers"."artist_cutover_approval_fingerprint" is not null)

music_distribution_delivery_events_statu.name: music_distribution_delivery_events_status_shape
music_distribution_delivery_events_statu.value: ("music_distribution_delivery_events"."event_type" = 'delivery_created' and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."previous_status" is null and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."next_status" = 'draft') or ("music_distribution_delivery_events"."event_type" = 'status_changed' and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."previous_status" is not null and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."next_status" is not null and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."previous_status" <> "music_distribution_delivery_events"."next_status") or ("music_distribution_delivery_events"."event_type" not in ('delivery_created', 'status_changed') and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."previous_status" is null and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."next_status" is null)

music_distribution_delivery_events_provi.name: music_distribution_delivery_events_provider_shape
music_distribution_delivery_events_provi.value: ("music_distribution_delivery_events"."event_type" = 'provider_webhook' and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."provider_event_id" is not null and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."payload_sha256" is not null and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."actor_user_id" is null) or ("music_distribution_delivery_events"."event_type" <> 'provider_webhook' and "music_distribution_delivery_events"."provider_event_id" is null)

payments_durable_action_link.name: payments_durable_action_link
payments_durable_action_link.value:
"payments"."legacy_unlinked"
    or (
      "payments"."performer_id" is not null
      and length(trim("payments"."idempotency_key")) > 0
      and length(trim("payments"."destination_account_id")) > 0
      and (
        ("payments"."action_type" in ('tip', 'request') and "payments"."request_id" is not null and "payments"."request_boost_id" is null)
        or ("payments"."action_type" = 'boost' and "payments"."request_id" is null and "payments"."request_boost_id" is not null)
      )
    )

performer_authority_events_actor_shape_v.name: performer_authority_events_actor_shape_valid
performer_authority_events_actor_shape_v.value:
(
    ("performer_authority_events"."actor_type" = 'admin' and "performer_authority_events"."actor_user_id" is not null)
    or
    ("performer_authority_events"."actor_type" = 'system' and "performer_authority_events"."actor_user_id" is null)
  )

performer_authority_events_expiry_valid.name: performer_authority_events_expiry_valid
performer_authority_events_expiry_valid.value:
(
    ("performer_authority_events"."decision" = 'granted' and ("performer_authority_events"."expires_at" is null or "performer_authority_events"."expires_at" > "performer_authority_events"."created_at"))
    or
    ("performer_authority_events"."decision" <> 'granted' and "performer_authority_events"."expires_at" is null)
  )

performer_capability_grant_events_actor_.name: performer_capability_grant_events_actor_shape_valid
performer_capability_grant_events_actor_.value:
(
    ("performer_capability_grant_events"."actor_type" = 'admin' and "performer_capability_grant_events"."actor_user_id" is not null)
    or
    ("performer_capability_grant_events"."actor_type" = 'system' and "performer_capability_grant_events"."actor_user_id" is null)
  )

performer_capability_grant_events_expiry.name: performer_capability_grant_events_expiry_valid
performer_capability_grant_events_expiry.value:
(
    ("performer_capability_grant_events"."decision" = 'granted' and ("performer_capability_grant_events"."expires_at" is null or "performer_capability_grant_events"."expires_at" > "performer_capability_grant_events"."created_at"))
    or
    ("performer_capability_grant_events"."decision" <> 'granted' and "performer_capability_grant_events"."expires_at" is null)
  )

performer_events_published_attendance_re.name: performer_events_published_attendance_ready
performer_events_published_attendance_re.value: "performer_events"."status" <> 'published' OR "performer_events"."attendance_mode" IN ('walk_in', 'native_ticket') OR "performer_events"."external_ticket_url" IS NOT NULL

performer_events_published_walk_in_has_l.name: performer_events_published_walk_in_has_location
performer_events_published_walk_in_has_l.value:
"performer_events"."status" <> 'published' OR "performer_events"."attendance_mode" <> 'walk_in' OR (
      "performer_events"."location_is_tba" = false
      AND "performer_events"."location_name" IS NOT NULL
      AND length(trim("performer_events"."location_name")) > 0
      AND (
        ("performer_events"."location_address" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("performer_events"."location_address")) > 0)
        OR ("performer_events"."city" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("performer_events"."city")) > 0)
      )
    )

performer_events_external_ticket_shape.name: performer_events_external_ticket_shape
performer_events_external_ticket_shape.value: ("performer_events"."external_ticket_url" IS NULL AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" IS NULL) OR ("performer_events"."external_ticket_url" IS NOT NULL AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" IS NOT NULL)

performer_events_ticketing_mode_exclusiv.name: performer_events_ticketing_mode_exclusive
performer_events_ticketing_mode_exclusiv.value: "performer_events"."ticketing_mode" = 'external' OR ("performer_events"."external_ticket_url" IS NULL AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" IS NULL)

performer_events_attendance_mode_shape.name: performer_events_attendance_mode_shape
performer_events_attendance_mode_shape.value:
(
      "performer_events"."attendance_mode" = 'walk_in'
      AND "performer_events"."ticketing_mode" = 'external'
      AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_url" IS NULL
      AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" IS NULL
    ) OR (
      "performer_events"."attendance_mode" = 'external_rsvp'
      AND "performer_events"."ticketing_mode" = 'external'
      AND (
        ("performer_events"."external_ticket_url" IS NULL AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" IS NULL)
        OR ("performer_events"."external_ticket_url" IS NOT NULL AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" = 'RSVP')
      )
    ) OR (
      "performer_events"."attendance_mode" = 'external_ticket'
      AND "performer_events"."ticketing_mode" = 'external'
      AND (
        ("performer_events"."external_ticket_url" IS NULL AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" IS NULL)
        OR ("performer_events"."external_ticket_url" IS NOT NULL AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" IN ('Get tickets', 'View details'))
      )
    ) OR (
      "performer_events"."attendance_mode" = 'native_ticket'
      AND "performer_events"."ticketing_mode" = 'native_ga'
      AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_url" IS NULL
      AND "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" IS NULL
    )

performer_events_external_ticket_label_a.name: performer_events_external_ticket_label_allowed
performer_events_external_ticket_label_a.value: "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" IS NULL OR "performer_events"."external_ticket_label" IN ('Get tickets', 'RSVP', 'View details')

performer_identity_events_custom_label_v.name: performer_identity_events_custom_label_valid
performer_identity_events_custom_label_v.value:
(
    ("performer_identity_events"."identity_kind" = 'other' and nullif(trim("performer_identity_events"."custom_label"), '') is not null and length(trim("performer_identity_events"."custom_label")) <= 80)
    or
    ("performer_identity_events"."identity_kind" <> 'other' and ("performer_identity_events"."custom_label" is null or (length(trim("performer_identity_events"."custom_label")) between 1 and 80)))
  )

performer_intent_events_payload_matches_.name: performer_intent_events_payload_matches_type
performer_intent_events_payload_matches_.value:
(
    ("performer_intent_events"."intent_type" = 'earning_mode' and "performer_intent_events"."earning_mode" is not null and "performer_intent_events"."desired_capability" is null)
    or
    ("performer_intent_events"."intent_type" = 'desired_capability' and "performer_intent_events"."desired_capability" is not null and "performer_intent_events"."earning_mode" is null)
  )

performers_handle_not_reserved.name: performers_handle_not_reserved
performers_handle_not_reserved.value: "performers"."handle" is null or lower("performers"."handle") not in ('admin', 'api', 'app', 'assets', 'auth', 'billing', 'contact', 'discover', 'g', 'help', 'login', 'logout', 'overlay', 'p', 'privacy', 'profile', 'public', 'room', 'settings', 'shells', 'signup', 'support', 'sway', 'talent', 'terms', 'www')

stripe_connect_onboarding_operations_lea.name: stripe_connect_onboarding_operations_lease_consistent
stripe_connect_onboarding_operations_lea.value:
(
      ("stripe_connect_onboarding_operations"."status" = 'provisioning' and "stripe_connect_onboarding_operations"."lease_token" is not null and "stripe_connect_onboarding_operations"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
      or
      ("stripe_connect_onboarding_operations"."status" <> 'provisioning' and "stripe_connect_onboarding_operations"."lease_token" is null and "stripe_connect_onboarding_operations"."lease_expires_at" is null)
    )

ticket_orders_offer_buyer_active_idx.name: ticket_orders_offer_buyer_active_idx
ticket_orders_offer_buyer_active_idx.where:
"ticket_orders"."status" in ('checkout_pending', 'checkout_open', 'payment_processing', 'paid', 'disputed')
      and not ("ticket_orders"."status" = 'disputed' and "ticket_orders"."refunded_at" is not null)

ticket_orders_final_charge_coherent.name: ticket_orders_final_charge_coherent
ticket_orders_final_charge_coherent.value:
(
      "ticket_orders"."tax_total_cents" is null
      and "ticket_orders"."charged_total_cents" is null
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_balance_transaction_id" is null
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_fee_cents" is null
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_net_cents" is null
    )
    or (
      "ticket_orders"."tax_total_cents" is not null
      and "ticket_orders"."tax_total_cents" >= 0
      and "ticket_orders"."charged_total_cents" = "ticket_orders"."advertised_total_cents" + "ticket_orders"."tax_total_cents"
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_balance_transaction_id" is not null
      and length(trim("ticket_orders"."processor_balance_transaction_id")) > 0
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_fee_cents" is not null
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_fee_cents" >= 0
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_net_cents" is not null
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_net_cents" = "ticket_orders"."charged_total_cents" - "ticket_orders"."processor_fee_cents"
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_net_cents" > 0
    )

ticket_orders_charged_state_coherent.name: ticket_orders_charged_state_coherent
ticket_orders_charged_state_coherent.value:
"ticket_orders"."status" not in ('paid', 'refund_pending', 'refunded', 'disputed')
    or (
      "ticket_orders"."charged_at" is not null
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_payment_intent_id" is not null
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_charge_id" is not null
      and "ticket_orders"."tax_total_cents" is not null
      and "ticket_orders"."charged_total_cents" is not null
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_balance_transaction_id" is not null
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_fee_cents" is not null
      and "ticket_orders"."processor_net_cents" is not null
    )

ticket_orders_state_timestamps.name: ticket_orders_state_timestamps
ticket_orders_state_timestamps.value:
("ticket_orders"."status" <> 'checkout_open' or ("ticket_orders"."processor_checkout_session_id" is not null and "ticket_orders"."checkout_expires_at" is not null))
    and ("ticket_orders"."status" <> 'payment_failed' or "ticket_orders"."payment_failed_at" is not null)
    and ("ticket_orders"."status" <> 'expired' or "ticket_orders"."expired_at" is not null)
    and ("ticket_orders"."status" <> 'refund_pending' or "ticket_orders"."refund_pending_at" is not null)
    and ("ticket_orders"."status" <> 'refunded' or ("ticket_orders"."refund_pending_at" is not null and "ticket_orders"."refunded_at" is not null))
    and ("ticket_orders"."status" <> 'disputed' or "ticket_orders"."disputed_at" is not null)
    and ("ticket_orders"."status" <> 'voided' or "ticket_orders"."voided_at" is not null)

ticket_payment_operations_lease_coherent.name: ticket_payment_operations_lease_coherent
ticket_payment_operations_lease_coherent.value:
("ticket_payment_operations"."status" = 'leased' and "ticket_payment_operations"."lease_owner" is not null and "ticket_payment_operations"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
    or ("ticket_payment_operations"."status" <> 'leased' and "ticket_payment_operations"."lease_owner" is null and "ticket_payment_operations"."lease_expires_at" is null)

ticket_payment_operations_ticket_require.name: ticket_payment_operations_ticket_required
ticket_payment_operations_ticket_require.value:
("ticket_payment_operations"."operation_type" in ('create_checkout', 'expire_checkout') and "ticket_payment_operations"."ticket_id" is null)
    or ("ticket_payment_operations"."operation_type" in ('create_seller_transfer', 'create_buyer_refund') and "ticket_payment_operations"."ticket_id" is not null)

ticket_payment_operations_amount_valid.name: ticket_payment_operations_amount_valid
ticket_payment_operations_amount_valid.value:
("ticket_payment_operations"."operation_type" = 'expire_checkout' and "ticket_payment_operations"."amount_cents" is null)
    or ("ticket_payment_operations"."operation_type" <> 'expire_checkout' and "ticket_payment_operations"."amount_cents" is not null and "ticket_payment_operations"."amount_cents" > 0)

ticket_payment_operations_completion_coh.name: ticket_payment_operations_completion_coherent
ticket_payment_operations_completion_coh.value:
("ticket_payment_operations"."status" not in ('succeeded', 'terminal_failed') and "ticket_payment_operations"."completed_at" is null)
    or ("ticket_payment_operations"."status" in ('succeeded', 'terminal_failed') and "ticket_payment_operations"."completed_at" is not null)

ticket_processor_events_processed_state.name: ticket_processor_events_processed_state
ticket_processor_events_processed_state.value:
("ticket_processor_events"."status" in ('processed', 'ignored') and "ticket_processor_events"."processed_at" is not null)
    or ("ticket_processor_events"."status" not in ('processed', 'ignored') and "ticket_processor_events"."processed_at" is null)
